The main takeaway from our work is that
14‐3–3 proteins are not only involved in signalling pathways that require a single phosphorylation event, but also those that involve multiple phosphorylation events.
the synergistic cross‐talk between signalling pathways is a generic phenomenon that does not require any special properties of the 14‐3–3 protein.
